description: Search DC Hub Capacity Source: listings of data-center capacity offered for sale or lease (powered land, powered shells, turnkey and colocation). Filter by size (min_kw in kW or min_mw in MW), region, location (a country, state or metro), market, delivery_type or available_by. A size is matched against what a listing can deliver (contiguous_kw, its largest contiguous block, and min_contract_kw, its smallest contractable chunk), not only its headline total. Returns listing cards with market, state, capacity, delivery type, availability and when each was last updated; the provider's identity is not included.

available_by.description: Browse filter: only listings available by this date, as YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. With a target it is the date the whole requirement must be deliverable by

delivery_type.description: Browse filter: how the capacity is delivered: land, powered_shell, turnkey or colocation

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

location.description: Browse filter: comma-separated free text matched against each listing's region, country, state and metro, e.g. "Germany" or "Texas, Phoenix"

market.description: Browse filter: market name as it appears on a listing, e.g. "Dallas"

max_providers.description: Match mode: how many different providers a bundle may use. Default: the same as max_sites

max_sites.description: Match mode: how many listings the requirement may be split across. Default one, which allows exact fits only; raise it to allow bundles

min_kw.description: Matched against what a listing can ACTUALLY deliver, not just its headline total: contiguous_kw is the largest single contiguous block available and min_contract_kw the smallest chunk the provider will contract, so a listing answers only when this size fits the block it declares — a site with a big total but a small contiguous block is not a hit, and a big site willing to contract small chunks is. A listing that declares neither is matched on its total.

min_mw.description: Matched against what a listing can ACTUALLY deliver, not just its headline total: contiguous_kw is the largest single contiguous block available and min_contract_kw the smallest chunk the provider will contract, so a listing answers only when this size fits the block it declares — a site with a big total but a small contiguous block is not a hit, and a big site willing to contract small chunks is. A listing that declares neither is matched on its total.

region.description: Browse filter: comma-separated regions from north_america, latin_america, europe, asia_pacific and middle_east_africa; the aliases emea, apac, latam and americas also work, e.g. "europe" or "emea, apac"

slug.description: One listing: its slug or numeric id exactly as items[].slug / items[].id return it. Omit to browse teaser cards

state.description: Browse filter: two-letter US state, e.g. "TX"

target_kw.description: Match mode: the whole requirement, in kW (target_mw is the same in MW; give one)

target_mw.description: Match mode: the whole requirement, in MW (target_kw is the same in kW; give one). Returns exact fits, bundles and a shortfall instead of teaser cards. Needs a signed-in human
